cohort: The participants were fifteen women aged 22-35 with a history of two or more second trimester abortions or early preterm labor, who had at least two previous unsuccessful vaginal cerclage or for whom vaginal cerclage was not possible.
finding: The new approach for laparoscopic cerclage was found to be a safe, effective, and reasonable treatment after failure of vaginal cerclage, with no intraoperative or major postoperative complications encountered.
mod_finding: Twelve participants delivered vaginally after cerclage removal, and two had CS due to breech presentation with the cerclage left in place.
